summary: Open text-to-speech model for natural multilingual speech in 30 languages, with voice design from a text description.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: VoxCPM is a tokenizer-free text-to-speech system that generates continuous speech directly with a diffusion autoregressive architecture. VoxCPM2, the latest release, is a 2B parameter model trained on over 2 million hours of speech and supports 30 languages.
sixtySeconds.problem: Many TTS systems sound robotic or need a sample voice. VoxCPM produces natural speech and can design a new voice from a text description, with style control.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an open, multilingual TTS model with a simple CLI, voice design, style control and optional word timestamps.

overview: Install with pip. The voxcpm CLI can design a voice from text, control style with a description like 'young female voice, warm and gentle', clone a voice from reference audio, and batch-process a text file.
Optional timestamps (pip install "voxcpm[timestamps]") add word or best-effort character timing after generation.
Voice cloning should only be used with the speaker's consent. The project is Apache 2.0 licensed.

features.title: Voice design
features.body: Create a voice from a text description.

limitations: Needs an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA 12+
Cloning a real person's voice needs their consent

install.verificationNote: Commands come from VoxCPM's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Install
steps.body: Needs Python 3.10 to 3.12, PyTorch 2.5+ and CUDA 12.0+.

firstRun.title: Generate speech with a designed voice
firstRun.code:
voxcpm design \
  --text "VoxCPM2 brings studio-quality multilingual speech synthesis." \
  --output out.wav

tutorial.title: Design a voice and control its style
tutorial.useCase: Create speech with a voice described in words.

steps.title: Generate with a style description
steps.code:
voxcpm design \
  --text "VoxCPM2 brings studio-quality multilingual speech synthesis." \
  --control "Young female voice, warm and gentle, slightly smiling" \
  --seed 42 \
  --output out.wav

steps.title: Listen to out.wav
steps.body: Change the --control text or --seed to try other voices.

tutorial.expected: out.wav contains the sentence spoken in the described style.
